scope: Independently written summary of local binary analysis and original-engine experiments. No proprietary code or assets are embedded.

initialized_sp_region.scope: One bounded code/data region observed after legitimate Steam startup, not the entire process or a rebuilt executable.

limits: Function discovery and decompilation are not independent runtime verification of every function.
Protected on-disk SP and MP images expose loader code; a complete original engine reconstruction was not achieved.
Raw initialized code, proprietary extracts and decompiler output remain local and ignored.

demonstrated_native_test.capture_correction: The original world capture predates correction of the entity-type field from event-byte offset +4 to SP eType offset +0. Position and player-movement results remain valid; that capture does not validate entity-type classification.

presentation_status.user_report: Partner still not visible; placement, camera, occlusion and rendered output need verification.

research_builds.opencod2: x86 build executed; its MP map path rejected the original Moscow campaign map.
research_builds.cod2m: x86 DLL built; not loaded into the original game.
research_builds.CoD2rev_Server: MSVC x86 portability probe failed; no executable produced.

next_acceptance_targets: Visible Soviet partner near the host, with natural movement and a head-anchored nametag.
A second original-engine client applying host-authoritative player and world state.
Shared AI, combat, interactions and mission progression without duplicate client authority.
Automated original-mission scenarios with engine-level assertions and captured failures.
A versioned cooperative checkpoint and restore implementation.
